decisions.reason: The burner component is embedded in the core radiant-heater business, costs little to maintain and supports existing installations, so continuing it needs no further justification.

The halogen heater is peripheral and close to the dropped panel line, so it faces real pruning risk, but it still fills a niche in the electric infrared range and weak results can be put down to the early market phase.

After dropping the panel and hydrogen flagships, this multi-model industrial hall heater line is the firm's main visible commitment to electrification and sits close to the core hall-heating business, so management stays with it.
